# AdaptiveModelPartitioning

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
Dynamic splitting of a model's computation graph across edge and cloud based on network conditions and resource availability. Optimizes latency and energy in TCC by aligning computation with network topology, reducing bottleneck links.
